title: Fluorine-rich Schiff base ligand derived Fe/N–C–F and Co/N–C–F catalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction: synthesis, experimental validation, and DFT insights
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01370K, Paper
Sumanta Kumar Das, Shaik Gouse Peera, Aiswarya Kesh, Prabakaran Varathan, Akhila Kumar Sahu
